test_captured_output: test that captured_output writes a message to stdout via pybind11 iostream binding
test_captured_err: test that captured_err writes a message to stderr via pybind11 iostream binding
test_ostream_redirect: test the ostream_redirect context manager to capture C++ stdout and stderr in Python
test_captured_utf8: test captured_output_default with large UTF-8 strings at various byte offsets in the buffer
test_threading: test ostream_redirect safety with multiple concurrent TestThread instances writing output
